properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-03 by the narrowing gate's first run: the VERIFIES narrowing of 2026-08-08 refused eight dropped targets on import naming NOTHING — Project, ChangeEvent, Actor, DriftEvent, EnvironmentRule, Flow, Anchor, DimensionAssessment — with no named replacement and no edge the schema models for the pair
properties.statement: OBSERVED: entry_problems on NARROWINGS' VERIFIES entry (to: '*' enumerated to Capability, Requirement, Artifact, Component, DesignRule, Constraint, Interface) reported eight pairs Verification -> T for which named_replacement was None and modelled_fits was empty: T = Project, ChangeEvent, Actor, DriftEvent, EnvironmentRule, Flow, Anchor, DimensionAssessment. So an import of an export holding any of them refused it with the bare 'Invalid edge' sentence. The Project case is live: dynograph-foundation's committed export holds five such checks (fact:dynograph-foundations-export-will-not-import-because-five-checks-verify-its-project). EXPECTED: a refusal that names what fits, as REALIZES's does. Repaired in the same change: narrowing::verifies_target_hint names GOVERNED_BY for a Decision, the Requirement or Capability for a Project, and for any other dropped target the list a check may verify (read from the schema), on import and in refused_by_schema findings.
